name: Powimo
positioning: Full-web property and condominium management software built to raise the productivity of property management firms.
description: Powimo is a SaaS software for property administrators (ADB) covering both syndic (condominium) and rental management activities. It is organized into modules covering mandates, accounting, general assemblies, tenant/owner extranet, move-in/move-out inspections, maintenance requests, and letting.
real_estate_use: A syndic manager uses Powimo to track co-ownership mandates, run accounting per building, prepare and hold dematerialized general assemblies, and issue fund calls to co-owners. A rental manager in the same firm uses it to manage lettings, tenant applications, and inspection reports, while owners and tenants follow their files through a dedicated client portal.

use_cases.job: Manage co-ownership mandates, budgets, fund calls and general assemblies
Handle rental management, letting and tenant applications
Consult accounting and documents through a dedicated client portal
